verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes Babylon.js scene or project formats as text-based, diffable or mergeable, and never mentions built-in multi-user collaboration or version-control integration. The listed file formats (.babylon, glTF) are not characterized as diffable or mergeable. Playground 'sharing' is a snippet-sharing feature, not team collaboration or version control, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration
